facts: p11-5c:Show that the kinetic energy of a rotating rigid body is ½Iω².
text: Show that the kinetic energy of a rotating rigid body is ½Iω².

points.text: Each particle has speed v = rω.
Its kinetic energy is ½m r²ω².
Adding over all particles gives ½(Σmr²)ω².
Since I = Σmr², K = ½Iω².
